backend/main.mo: Defines the actor’s data models for users, providers, clients, jobs, documents, and platform stats with various profile and verification types.
backend/migration.mo: Provides a no-op migration that returns the old state unchanged while enabling new methods.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report listing affected frontend files and components for two client-profile update features.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Prewritten summaries describing many frontend components, hooks, pages, and utilities across the project.
frontend/index.css: Defines Tailwind base styles and extensive OKLCH color variables for light and dark themes.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point setting up PWA metadata, manifest links, and loading the main React script.
frontend/public/.well-known/ic-domains: Lists the IC domain used for canister verification.
frontend/public/manifest.webmanifest: PWA manifest defining app metadata, icons, colors, and categories.
frontend/public/offline.html: Standalone offline fallback page shown when the user has no internet connection.
frontend/public/sw.js: Service worker handling precaching, versioned cache management, offline fallback, and selective request interception.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Main app component managing routing, authentication state, profile completion checks, and page navigation.
frontend/src/components/AppLayout.tsx: Layout wrapper providing header, footer, and support drawer around page content.
frontend/src/components/auth/LoginButton: Login/logout button using Internet Identity with loading and error handling.
frontend/src/components/auth/PhoneOtpVer: Empty placeholder file for phone OTP verification UI.
frontend/src/components/auth/RoleOnboard: Role selection form that saves initial user profile data and triggers onboarding completion.
frontend/src/components/Footer.tsx: Footer showing copyright, support trigger, and attribution link.
frontend/src/components/Header.tsx: Header with role‑based navigation, branding, and mobile menu support.
frontend/src/components/landing/DemoVide: Landing page section showing a placeholder for a demo video.
frontend/src/components/landing/Platform: Landing page stats section displaying animated client and provider counts using backend data.
frontend/src/components/landing/RoleQuic: Displays quick-select role cards and handles navigation based on authentication and profile loading state.
frontend/src/components/landing/Testimon: Renders a testimonials grid with reviewer feedback, ratings, and provider avatars.
frontend/src/components/landing/useLandi: Empty placeholder file with no implemented logic.
frontend/src/components/location/Locatio: Provides inputs for address and coordinates with optional geolocation to update a Location value.
frontend/src/components/messaging/Conver: Implements a simple messaging UI with send, refresh, and message display for client-provider chats.
frontend/src/components/notifications/En: Shows a temporary alert indicating whether a provider is engaged or not, with auto-hide and dismiss support.
frontend/src/components/payments/MpesaUn: Dialog for unlocking provider contact details via M‑Pesa, simulating payment flow with input, processing, and success states.
frontend/src/components/providers/Featur: Avatar component that displays provider images with fallback initials and size options.
Displays a grid of hardcoded featured providers with avatars, ratings, and details using UI cards.
frontend/src/components/providers/Provid: Renders a provider avatar with optional image and fallback initials in multiple sizes.
Shows a detailed provider card with avatar, verification and engagement badges, rating, and category info.
Provides a modal preview of a provider with avatar, verification status, availability, ratings, and actions.
frontend/src/components/providers/Unlock: Displays locked contact details with explanation and a button to pay a connection fee to unlock.
frontend/src/components/pwa/InstallPromp: Shows a PWA install banner with iOS-specific instructions and dismiss handling.
frontend/src/components/pwa/UpdateAvaila: Alerts users when a service worker update is available with options to refresh or dismiss.
frontend/src/components/ratings/StarRati: Displays average rating with full, half, and empty stars and handles no-rating cases.
Interactive star rating input allowing users to select a rating unless readonly.
frontend/src/components/support/SupportD: Provides a drawer UI showing contact options for phone and email support with closing actions.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Creates and manages a backend actor tied to the user's identity, refreshing queries on identity changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useCountUpOnVisible.t: Implements a count‑up animation that starts when an element becomes visible using IntersectionObserver.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Manages Internet Identity authentication state, login flow, and persistence via an AuthClient provider context.
frontend/src/hooks/usePWAInstallPrompt.t: Tracks PWA installability and installation status, exposing a prompt function and iOS detection.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Defines data‑fetching and mutation hooks using react‑query for profiles, providers, stats, and admin checks via the backend actor.
frontend/src/hooks/useServiceWorkerUpdat: Detects service worker updates and exposes a method to trigger skip‑waiting and reload.
frontend/src/index.css: Tailwind setup defining light/dark theme variables and component styles, including a themed landing background.
frontend/src/lib/categories.ts: Defines the Category interface and exports a large list of service categories with associated business types and icons.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Bootstraps the React app, wrapping it with React Query and Internet Identity providers.
frontend/src/pages/auth/ClientAccessPage: Provides login and account-creation flows for clients using Internet Identity with tabbed UI.
frontend/src/pages/auth/ProviderAccessPa: Provides login and account-creation flows for service providers using Internet Identity with tabbed UI.
frontend/src/pages/backoffice/ProviderDa: Admin panel for seeding and deleting provider datasets, with feedback alerts and permission handling.
frontend/src/pages/backoffice/Verificati: Displays verification review UI and includes admin-only provider dataset tools.
frontend/src/pages/client/CategoriesPage: Displays searchable service categories and navigates to results or all providers.
frontend/src/pages/client/ClientProfileP: Loads and edits client profile, required fields, location, and biodata with validation and save actions.
frontend/src/pages/client/MapViewPage.ts: Placeholder page showing an upcoming interactive map for locating providers.
frontend/src/pages/client/MyJobsPage.tsx: Placeholder page for managing and viewing client job requests.
frontend/src/pages/client/ProviderDetail: Fetches and displays detailed provider info with engagement tracking and navigation options.
frontend/src/pages/client/ProviderResult: Fetches provider lists by category, shows previews with polling, and allows opening details or map view.
frontend/src/pages/LandingPage.tsx: Implements the landing page UI with hero content, provider highlights, stats, demos, and navigation based on authentication state.
frontend/src/pages/provider/ProviderProf: Loads provider profile, supports editing details, managing engagement status, and updating location.
frontend/src/pages/provider/Verification: Displays provider verification status using profile data and shows placeholder messaging for future document uploads.
frontend/src/utils/engagementTime.ts: Provides utilities to compute, format, and check remaining engagement time based on a bigint end timestamp.
frontend/src/utils/fees.ts: Calculates a 10% connection fee from a provider rate and formats KES amounts for display.
Stores, retrieves, and clears a pending user role in sessionStorage with validation.
frontend/src/utils/profileCompletion.ts: Checks client and provider profiles for missing fields and returns profile completion status.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Handles reading, persisting, and clearing URL parameters using query strings, hash routing, and sessionStorage.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: TailwindCSS configuration defining theme extensions, colors, fonts, and plugin usage.
project_state.json: Project state metadata describing known issues, existing features, and pending backend requirements for client profile saving.
